ollama.dataLocation: On this server or a GPU server on the network; data does not leave the network.
ollama.note: The safest option for KVKK. DeepSeek and Qwen open-weight models run locally with Ollama.

vllm.dataLocation: On a server on the network; data does not leave the network.
vllm.note: For tool calls, start the server with --enable-auto-tool-choice and a suitable --tool-call-parser.

lmstudio.dataLocation: On this computer; data does not leave the network.

deepseek.dataLocation: On DeepSeek's servers in the People's Republic of China (according to its privacy policy).
deepseek.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects. Use the DeepSeek cloud API only for demo or non-sensitive projects; for KVKK the safe option is to run DeepSeek / Qwen open-weight models locally with Ollama.
deepseek.note: The reasoning_content field never mixes into the answer or the JSON. The old deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner names were removed on 24.07.2026; the model ID can be edited. Ollama's deepseek-v4 ":cloud" tags also run in the cloud.

openai.dataLocation: On OpenAI's servers in the USA; projects with data residency can choose regions such as the EU (there is no Türkiye region).
openai.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects.

gemini.dataLocation: On Google's global infrastructure (the Gemini API has no region choice); on the free tier, prompts may be used for product development.
gemini.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects. Use the paid tier only.
gemini.note: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (beta). Thinking cannot be turned off in Gemini 3.

anthropic.dataLocation: On Anthropic's servers (global by default; optionally US only).
anthropic.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects.
anthropic.note: There is no JSON mode; JSON is requested in the prompt and extracted by the application.

mistral.dataLocation: In Mistral's data centres in the EU/EFTA (guaranteed with the api.eu.mistral.ai address).
mistral.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects.

groq.dataLocation: On Groq's servers in the USA (Google Cloud); default retention 30 days.
groq.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects.

openrouter.dataLocation: Through OpenRouter (USA) to the provider of the selected model; the region depends on the model.
openrouter.kvkk: Project content is transferred to servers outside Türkiye (KVKK Art. 9): explicit consent or another valid transfer basis is required. Use a local model for sensitive projects.
openrouter.note: Many models with one key; the model ID is in provider/model format.

azure-openai.dataLocation: In the Azure region you choose; Global deployments may process data in any region, a Data Zone (EU) deployment stays in the EU.
azure-openai.kvkk: If the region is outside Türkiye, project content is transferred abroad (KVKK Art. 9).
azure-openai.note: Replace the address with your resource name and the model field with your deployment name.
